alignment_scope: DCAS evaluates TSMM-aligned TIS v0.10 runtime assurance artifacts as evidence inputs without copying canonical schemas or redefining TSMM semantics.
tracked_artifact_families: VTI ACL, authorization credential, and status-list reference profiles
OpenVTC state normalization and task evidence profiles
Trust Task reference, manifest reference, lifecycle event, and execution receipt schemas
drift_triggers: changed authority, delegation, revocation, expiry, or scope semantics
changed decision receipt or evidence bundle manifest structure
changed TSMM runtime governance projection semantics
changed VTI capability, ACL role, or status-list semantics
changed evidence bundle integrity or detached proof requirements
required_action_on_drift: Open a DCAS drift review and update evaluator guidance, examples, compatibility matrix, or validation checks as needed.
